title: Demethylmycemycin A, a dibenzoxazepinone from the marine-derived Dactylosporangium sp. OK1079, with prostate cancer suppressive effects via targeting BRK-FAK-STAT3 axis.
authors: Elsbaey, Marwa; Tarun, Md Towhidul Islam; Alnajjar, Radwan; Jomori, Takahiro; Tanaka, Junichi; Oku, Naoya; El Sayed, Khalid; Igarashi, Yasuhiro
one_liner_zh: 该文研究海洋来源化合物DA通过靶向BRK-FAK-STAT3信号轴抑制前列腺癌，仅涉及分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Breast tumor kinase (Brk) is an intracellular kinase that initiates a downstream oncogenic signaling through phosphorylation of focal adhesion kinase (FAK) and signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3). Demethylmycemycin A (DA) was isolated from a sponge-derived Dactylosporangium sp. OK1079. Though known as a microbial dibenzoxazepinone, its biological activity has never been investigated. Previous studies on the marine triterpene sipholenol A identified its perhydrobenzoxepine system as the key pharmacophore that mediated its Brk binding. The bioisosteric similarity of DA to the sipholenol A perhydrobenzoxepine motivated a molecular docking simulation of DA for potential Brk binding. The antiproliferative effect of DA was investigated against diverse prostate cancer (PC) cell lines including LNCaP (castration/hormone-sensitive primary adenocarcinoma), PC3, and 22Rv1 (castration-resistant), in addition to the androgen-independent DU145 cells. LNCaP cells were the most sensitive to the effects of DA, followed by PC3, showing IC(50) values of 7.6 and 9.8 muM, respectively. DA treatments significantly reduced the migration and clonogenicity of the LNCaP cells. Western blot analysis indicated the ability of DA to reduce the expression levels of activated Brk, FAK and STAT3 in a dose-dependent manner in both cell lines. DA also decreased the expression levels of the total FAK but didn't affect the total level of Brk while the expression level of total STAT3 was only suppressed in LNCaP cells. These results highlight the PC proliferation and migration suppressive effects of DA through targeting Brk-FAK-STAT3 axis. DA is a potential prototype hit that can be developed particularly for Brk-expressing PC control.
abstract_zh: 乳腺肿瘤激酶（Brk）是一种胞内激酶，通过磷酸化黏着斑激酶（FAK）和信号转导及转录激活因子3（STAT3）启动下游致癌信号传导。去甲基麦西霉素A（DA）是从海绵来源的指孢囊菌属（Dactylosporangium sp.）OK1079中分离得到的。尽管已知其为微生物来源的二苯并氧杂氮杂䓬酮，但其生物活性从未被研究过。先前对海洋三萜类化合物sipholenol A的研究鉴定出其全氢苯并氧杂环庚烷系统是介导其与Brk结合的关键药效团。DA与sipholenol A全氢苯并氧杂环庚烷之间的生物电子等排相似性促使对DA进行分子对接模拟以评估其潜在的Brk结合能力。研究了DA对多种前列腺癌（PC）细胞系的抗增殖作用，包括LNCaP（去势/激素敏感性原发腺癌）、PC3和22Rv1（去势抵抗性），以及雄激素非依赖性DU145细胞。LNCaP细胞对DA的作用最敏感，其次是PC3，其IC(50)值分别为7.6和9.8 μM。DA处理显著降低了LNCaP细胞的迁移能力和克隆形成能力。Western blot分析表明，DA能够以剂量依赖性方式降低两种细胞系中活化Brk、FAK和STAT3的表达水平。DA还降低了总FAK的表达水平，但不影响总Brk水平，而总STAT3的表达水平仅在LNCaP细胞中受到抑制。这些结果突显了DA通过靶向Brk-FAK-STAT3轴发挥的前列腺癌增殖和迁移抑制作用。DA是一个潜在的先导化合物，可特别开发用于表达Brk的前列腺癌控制。
